model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between "Co-occurrence Number" and "ACC (%)" across six different configurations: Base, FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT, and ROME. The x-axis, labeled "Co-occurrence Number," uses a logarithmic scale with major tick marks labeled at 0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis, labeled "ACC (%)," employs a linear scale with tick marks set at regular intervals of 5, ranging from 40 to 65. The "Base" configuration is depicted by a solid grey line with circular markers, starting at an initial value of approximately 38, increasing, and then leveling off to end at roughly 44 at the highest x-axis value. The "FT" configuration is shown as a solid light blue line with downward-pointing triangle markers, rising steadily from approximately 40 at the start to 48 at the end. The "IKE" configuration, represented by a solid light red line with upward-pointing triangle markers, increases from roughly 43 initially to end at approximately 49.5. The "MEND" configuration is displayed as a solid tan line with diamond markers, beginning at approximately 44.5 and climbing to end at roughly 56.5. The "MEMIT" configuration uses a solid light purple line with pentagon markers, starting at approximately 43.5, rising more sharply to 51 at the second data point, and concluding at approximately 55. Finally, the "ROME" configuration is plotted as a solid light green line with square markers, starting at 51 and following a steady upward trend to finish at 66.
